description: Add a negative PLACEMENT (website URL or mobile app) exclusion to a campaign so ads never serve there. Use to block click-fraud / low-quality placements (e.g. qureka.com, omegleweb.io, junk Google Play apps).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID to add the exclusion to

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

placementUrl.description: Placement to exclude — a website URL (e.g. "qureka.com") or app id.

name: gads_add_negative_placement
